system.description:
Contest: your Strength check vs. target's Strength or Dexterity check (their choice). You win, it is Restrained (see Unarmed Combat & Grappling).

Combat Manoeuvres, Manoeuvre: replaces one attack.

  • Size: you can grapple, shove or trip only a creature up to one size larger than you.
  • Winning: the target is Restrained (Disadvantage on its attacks, and attacks against it have Advantage) until it breaks free (see Restrained; for a grapple, the check is contested by the grappler's Strength).
  • Grappled casters can't perform somatic components: they can cast only spells with no S component.
  • Knocking down: grappling doesn't knock a target Prone by itself.
  • To knock a Restrained target down, spend a further attack to Overbear it (a second contest).
  • To knock someone down without grappling first, use the Trip manoeuvre instead.
  • Standing up: one creature standing over a Prone target never stops it standing up on its own turn. Being surrounded by several creatures might, at the GM's call.

Contest: both sides roll d20 + the stated attribute modifier; the higher total wins and ties go to the defender.

Target one creature and press Use: both sides roll, and the result is applied.
